characteristics.description: Institutional characteristics for each school in a given year, including information like a school's name and address; available for years 1984-2024.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.name: Name of institution location.
variables.webaddress: Admissions website URL of institution location.

admissions.description: Admissions data for each school in a given year (measured in the Fall), including information like ACT/SAT scores and acceptance rates by gender; available for years 2001-2024.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.tot_applied: Total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking applicants in a given year.
variables.tot_admitted: Total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking applicants who were admitted in a given year.
variables.tot_enrolled: Total number of admitteees who ultimately enrolled (includes part-time and full-time enrollemnt).
variables.men_applied: Number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking men who applied to an institution in a given year.
variables.men_admitted: Number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking men who were admitted to an institution in a given year.
variables.men_enrolled: Number of admitted men who ultimately enrolled (includes part-time and full-time enrollemnt).
variables.yield_rate_men: Yield rate (share of admitted students who ultimately enrolled) of male admittees.
variables.yield_rate_women: Yield rate (share of admitted students who ultimately enrolled) of female admittees.
variables.men_applied_share: Male share of total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking applicants in a given year.
variables.men_admitted_share: Male share of total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking admittees in a given year.
variables.share_submit_sat: Share of admitted students who submitted an SAT score.
variables.share_submit_act: Share of admitted students who submitted an ACT score.

enrollment.description: Enrollment data for each school in a given year (measured in the Fall), including information like the male enrollment share and enrollment by gender and race; available at the undergraduate or graduate level; available for years 1984-2024.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.studentlevel: Level of student enrollment; either 'undergrad' (Undergraduate) or 'grad' (Graduate).
variables.totmen: Total number of men enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totwomen: Total number of women enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.wtmen: Total number of non-Hispanic White men enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.wtwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic White women enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.bkmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black men enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.bkwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black women enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.hspmen: Total number of Hispanic men (of any race) enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.hspwomen: Total number of Hispanic women (of any race) enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.asnmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian men enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.asnwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian women enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totmen_share: Male share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totwt_share: Non-Hispanic White share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totbk_share: Non-Hispanic Black share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.tothsp_share: Hispanic share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totasn_share: Non-Hispanic Asian share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.

tuition.description: Published undergraduate tuition and required fees, 2000-2024. Academic-year and program-year reporters are separate; 2024 moves from Institutional Characteristics to Cost I.

variables.year: Starting year of the published academic or program price period (e.g. 2024 means 2024-25).
variables.reporter: Academic-year or program-year price reporter; values academic or program.
variables.largest_program_cip: CIP code of largest program at program-year reporters; not a standardized price for every program.
variables.in_district_tuition: Average in-district tuition for full-time undergraduates at academic-year reporters; dollars, excluding required fees (TUITION1).
variables.in_district_fees: Required in-district fees for full-time undergraduates; dollars (FEE1).
variables.in_district_published_tuition_fees: Published in-district tuition plus required fees for full-time first-time undergraduates; dollars (CHG1AY3).
variables.in_state_tuition: Average in-state tuition for full-time undergraduates at academic-year reporters; dollars, excluding required fees (TUITION2).
variables.in_state_fees: Required in-state fees for full-time undergraduates; dollars (FEE2).
variables.in_state_published_tuition_fees: Published in-state tuition plus required fees for full-time first-time undergraduates; dollars (CHG2AY3).
variables.out_of_state_tuition: Average out-of-state tuition for full-time undergraduates at academic-year reporters; dollars, excluding required fees (TUITION3).
variables.out_of_state_fees: Required out-of-state fees for full-time undergraduates; dollars (FEE3).
variables.out_of_state_published_tuition_fees: Published out-of-state tuition plus required fees for full-time first-time undergraduates; dollars (CHG3AY3).
variables.program_published_tuition_fees: Published tuition plus required fees for the largest program for entering students at program-year reporters; dollars (CHG1PY3).
variables.largest_program_tuition_fees_no_ftft: Largest-program tuition plus required fees for institutions without full-time first-time undergraduates; dollars (CIPTUIT1), available from 2006.

student_aid.description: IPEDS Student Financial Aid grants and loans, for aid years ending 2002-2024. Early academic/program reporting cohorts and the all-undergraduate measures have different availability and denominators.

variables.year: Ending year of the aid period; e.g. SFA2324 describes aid year 2023-24, so year is 2024.
variables.aid_year_start: Starting year of the aid period (year minus one).
variables.reporter: Academic-year (fall cohort) or program-year (full-year cohort) aid reporting; academic or program.
variables.ftft_students: Full-time first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate financial-aid cohort; SCUGFFN from aid year 2007-08, otherwise SCFA1N (academic) or SCFY1N (program).
variables.ftft_students_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for the corresponding ftft_students source field.
variables.ug_students: Total undergraduate financial-aid cohort; SCUGRAD from aid year 2007-08, otherwise SCFA2 (academic) or SCFY2 (program).
variables.ug_students_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for the corresponding ug_students source field.
variables.ftft_net_price: Average net price for in-state/in-district FTFT undergraduates receiving federal, state/local, or institutional grants; dollars, available for aid years 2008-09 through 2023-24 (NPIST2; 2023-24 from Cost II).
variables.ftft_any_aid_count: FTFT students receiving/awarded any financial aid (ANYAIDN).
variables.ftft_any_aid_pct: NCES-published percentage of FTFT students receiving/awarded any financial aid (ANYAIDP).
variables.ftft_federal_grant_avg: Average federal grant dollars among FTFT federal-grant recipients (FGRNT_A).
variables.ftft_federal_grant_total: Total federal grant dollars to FTFT recipients (FGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_state_local_grant_avg: Average state/local grant dollars among FTFT recipients (SGRNT_A).
variables.ftft_state_local_grant_total: Total state/local grant dollars to FTFT recipients (SGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_institutional_grant_avg: Average institutional grant dollars among FTFT recipients (IGRNT_A).
variables.ftft_institutional_grant_total: Total institutional grant dollars to FTFT recipients (IGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_student_loan_count: FTFT recipients of student loans (LOAN_N), which may include nonfederal loans.
variables.ftft_student_loan_avg: Average student-loan dollars among FTFT loan recipients (LOAN_A).
variables.ftft_student_loan_total: Total student-loan dollars to FTFT recipients (LOAN_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_grant_count: FTFT recipients of federal, state/local or institutional grants (AGRNT_N); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_grant_avg: Average grant dollars among FTFT grant recipients (AGRNT_A); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_grant_total: Total grant dollars to FTFT recipients (AGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_pell_count: FTFT Pell Grant recipients (PGRNT_N); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_pell_avg: Average Pell Grant dollars among FTFT Pell recipients (PGRNT_A); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_pell_total: Total Pell Grant dollars to FTFT recipients (PGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_federal_loan_count: FTFT recipients of federal student loans (FLOAN_N); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_federal_loan_avg: Average federal loan dollars among FTFT federal-loan recipients (FLOAN_A); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_federal_loan_total: Total federal loan dollars to FTFT recipients (FLOAN_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_grant_count: All-undergraduate recipients of grants from federal, state/local, institutional or other sources (UAGRNTN); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_grant_avg: Average grant dollars among undergraduate grant recipients (UAGRNTA); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_grant_total: Total grant dollars to undergraduate grant recipients (UAGRNTT); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_pell_count: All-undergraduate Pell recipients (UPGRNTN); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_pell_avg: Average Pell Grant dollars among undergraduate Pell recipients (UPGRNTA); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_pell_total: Total Pell Grant dollars to undergraduate Pell recipients (UPGRNTT); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_federal_loan_count: All-undergraduate federal student-loan recipients (UFLOANN); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_federal_loan_avg: Average federal-loan dollars among undergraduate federal-loan recipients (UFLOANA); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_federal_loan_total: Total federal-loan dollars to undergraduate federal-loan recipients (UFLOANT); available from aid year 2008-09.

student_aid_net_price.description: Cost II net-price supplement for StudentAid in aid year 2023-24.

veterans_aid.description: Post-9/11 GI Bill and DoD Tuition Assistance benefits, by undergraduate and graduate level; SFAV aid years ending 2014-2024.

variables.year: Ending year of the benefit period (2014 means 2013-14).
variables.aid_year_start: Starting year of the benefit period (year minus one).
variables.ug_post911_total: Post-9/11 GI Bill dollars awarded to undergraduates (UGPO9_T).
variables.ug_post911_avg: Average Post-9/11 GI Bill dollars per undergraduate recipient (UGPO9_A).
variables.grad_post911_total: Post-9/11 GI Bill dollars awarded to graduate students (GPO9_T).
variables.grad_post911_avg: Average Post-9/11 GI Bill dollars per graduate recipient (GPO9_A).
variables.ug_dod_total: DoD Tuition Assistance dollars awarded to undergraduates (UGDOD_T).
variables.ug_dod_avg: Average DoD Tuition Assistance dollars per undergraduate recipient (UGDOD_A).
variables.grad_dod_total: DoD Tuition Assistance dollars awarded to graduate students (GDOD_T).
variables.grad_dod_avg: Average DoD Tuition Assistance dollars per graduate recipient (GDOD_A).

retention.description: First-year retention of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates, by full-time or part-time entering status; Fall Enrollment D files, 2003-2024. The reporting year is the fall when retention is measured, one year after entry.

variables.year: Fall reporting year in which retention is measured.
variables.cohort_year: Fall entering-cohort year; one year before the retention reporting year.
variables.ft_cohort: Full-time first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate cohort in the previous fall; available from 2007.
variables.ft_exclusions: Permitted exclusions from the prior-fall full-time cohort; available from 2007.
variables.ft_inclusions: Study-abroad students re-included in the full-time cohort; available from 2016.
variables.ft_adjusted_cohort: Prior-fall full-time cohort after exclusions and, from 2016, inclusions; available from 2007.
variables.ft_retained: Full-time entering-cohort students retained at the institution in the reporting fall (and qualifying early completers); available from 2007.
variables.ft_retention_rate: NCES-published first-year full-time entering-cohort retention rate, percent; available from 2003.
variables.pt_cohort: Part-time first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate cohort in the previous fall; available from 2007.
variables.pt_exclusions: Permitted exclusions from the prior-fall part-time cohort; available from 2007.
variables.pt_inclusions: Study-abroad students re-included in the part-time cohort; available from 2016.
variables.pt_adjusted_cohort: Prior-fall part-time cohort after exclusions and, from 2016, inclusions; available from 2007.
variables.pt_retained: Part-time entering-cohort students retained at the institution in the reporting fall (and qualifying early completers); available from 2007.
variables.pt_retention_rate: NCES-published first-year part-time entering-cohort retention rate, percent; available from 2003.
variables.ft_cohort_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_cohort; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_exclusions_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_exclusions; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_inclusions_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_inclusions; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_adjusted_cohort_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_adjusted_cohort; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_retained_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_retained; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_retention_rate_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_retention_rate; e.g., R reported, A not applicable, B blank, Z implied zero, or a correction/imputation code.
variables.pt_cohort_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_cohort; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_exclusions_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_exclusions; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_inclusions_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_inclusions; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_adjusted_cohort_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_adjusted_cohort; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_retained_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_retained; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_retention_rate_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_retention_rate; e.g., R reported, A not applicable, B blank, Z implied zero, or a correction/imputation code.

completion.description: Completion data for each school in a given year by detailed subject field, including information like the male completion share within a subject (e.g., Economics); available at the Associate, Bachelor's, Master's or Doctoral level; available for years 1984-2024.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.year: Survey year. Note that the cohort being tracked is the cohort that started either six years back (for bachelor) or three years back (for associate).
variables.cip: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) code for a subject in a given year.
variables.totmen: Total number of male completers within a CIP subject.
variables.totwomen: Total number of female completers within a CIP subject.
variables.wtmen: Total number of non-Hispanic White men completers within a CIP subject.; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.wtwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic White women completers within a CIP subject.; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.bkmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black men completers within a CIP subject.; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.bkwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black women completers within a CIP subject.; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.hspmen: Total number of Hispanic men (of any race) completers within a CIP subject.; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.hspwomen: Total number of Hispanic women (of any race) completers within a CIP subject.; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.asnmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian men completers within a CIP subject.; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.asnwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian women completers within a CIP subject.; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totwt_share: Non-Hispanic White share of total (male and female) completers within a CIP subject.
variables.totbk_share: Non-Hispanic Black share of total (male and female) completers within a CIP subject.
variables.tothsp_share: Hispanic share of total (male and female) completers within a CIP subject.
variables.totasn_share: Non-Hispanic Asian share of total (male and female) completers within a CIP subject.
variables.totmen_share: Male share of total (male and female) completers within a CIP subject.
variables.deglevel: Degree level of completers; options include 'assc' (Associate's), 'bach' (Bachelor's), 'mast' (Master's), and 'doct' (Doctoral).

graduation.description: Graduation data for each school in a given year, including information like the graduation rate by gender and race; available at the Associate or Bachelor's level; available for years 2000-2024.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.year: Survey year. Note that the cohort being tracked is the cohort that started either six years back (for bachelor) or three years back (for associate).
variables.deglevel: Level of student degree; either 'bach' (Bachelor's) or 'assc' (Associates).
variables.totmen: Total number of men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.totmen_graduated: Total number of men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.totwomen: Total number of women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.totwomen_graduated: Total number of women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.wtmen: Total number of non-Hispanic White men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.wtmen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic White men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.wtwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic White women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.wtwomen_graduated: Total number of  non-Hispanic White women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.bkmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.bkmen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic Black men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.bkwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.bkwomen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic Black women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.hspmen: Total number of Hispanic men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.hspmen_graduated: Total number of Hispanic men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.hspwomen: Total number of Hispanic women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.hspwomen_graduated: Total number of Hispanic women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.asnmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.asnmen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.asnwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.asnwomen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.gradrate_totmen: Graduation rate for men (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_totwomen: Graduation rate for women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_wtmen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic White men (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_wtwomen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic White women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_bkmen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic Black men (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_bkwomen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic Black women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_hspmen: Graduation rate for Hispanic men (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_hspwomen: Graduation rate for Hispanic women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_asnmen: Graduation rate for  non-Hispanic Asianmen (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_asnwomen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic Asian women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).

cip.description: Provides subject field codes for subjects in a given year; should be used with Completion data; available for years 1984-2024.

variables.year: Survey year. Note that the cohort being tracked is the cohort that started either six years back (for bachelor) or three years back (for associate).
variables.cip: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) identifier code.
